# S0.3b — cross-candidate / MCP-ACP online measurement spike (closes DF-S0.3-1, DF-S0.3-3 machine cells)

## Summary
Inserted Stage-0 ticket, run under the operator's **online** spike budget (network + candidate
E2/E3 toolchains + official MCP/ACP SDKs against **local** reference peers; **no external model
spend**). Closes the machine-achievable cells S0.3 deferred offline: the official-SDK MCP/ACP
round-trip (M-S1-7), the **cross-candidate** half of gate G1 (E2/E3 reproduce a byte-identical hash
chain), and the **cross-candidate scoring** of E2/E3 (C5/C7) plus the E5b/E5c splits (C12 transport).
Throwaway spike (R1–R6), committed-but-deletable at the Stage-0 boundary. **No harness claim is made
at Stage 0** (R5); these are internal tier-B numbers.

## Design decisions
- **Matched-budget (CC9).** One shared corpus (`corpus_sha256` pinned + re-checked per candidate); the
  same C5/C7 formulas as S0.3 for every candidate; matched E-kernel↔E-kernel per-run crossing overhead
  for the splits. **CC4:** no language named in the sheet/tickets/ledger — bindings live only in ADR-0225.
- **G1 is a real implementation-independence test:** each candidate builds the chain with its own
  serializer; a byte-identical head is the proof (a mutated corpus is rejected — live negative test).
- **Honesty (no fabricated green):** the polyglot C12 conjunct (two-toolchain CI + cross-ecosystem
  serialization COST) stays deferred (DF-S0.3-2, Stage 3, not pulled forward); the **R2 cross-camp
  human reviewer signature** is left OPEN (a human deliverable); the E2 outside-band C5/C7 result is
  reported truthfully and **arms trigger 5** (routed to GATE-G1), not massaged to "within band".
- **Single-executor deviation from R1** (fresh agent per candidate) recorded in ADR-0225 with the
  objective G1 byte-identity gate as the anti-bias compensating control.

## Verification
- `bash spikes/s0.3b-online-spike/test-gates.sh` → **ALL GATES PASS (exit 0)**: G1 E2/E3 byte-identity
  + a live **negative** test (mutated corpus rejected); M-S1-7 MCP echo + ACP session verified (E2/E3);
  M-S2-7 cross-ecosystem hash-equality 100% (E5b/E5c).
- `python3 spikes/s0.3b-online-spike/run-sheet.py 5` → N=5 distributions.
- `cargo test --workspace` → 84 tests / 16 suites green (persistent kernel unaffected). `cargo fmt --all --check` clean.
